narrative: Material PL1__M2D94E9C shows normal-regime demand with high variability (CV=0.58) and a moderately variable lead time averaging 2.56 working days. The current SAP safety stock of 0 units is insufficient for a 95% service level target; an (r,Q) policy with safety stock 862 units and order quantity 559 units is recommended. Demand variability dominates buffer requirements (91.2% of variance), and the proposed policy respects the 3,400-unit storage constraint with total annual cost savings of approximately $1,698 (11.6%).

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is frequent (97% non-zero days) with no significant trend, making a continuous-review (r,Q) policy optimal. EOQ balances ordering and holding costs efficiently, and the reorder point with safety stock handles variability without triggering periodic review overhead.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Order quantity (559) is well below the storage constraint binding level (3,400 - 862 = 2,539 available). No capacity constraint binds; full EOQ is achievable.
